name: Europäischer Fernwanderweg E1 - Teil Deutschland, Hessen (Gebiet Odenwald Nord)
description_md:
The European long distance path E1 in the Hessen region of the North Odenwald in Germany is a waymarked hiking route. It covers a distance of 95.4 km within the international waymarked hiking network.

This hard route requires about 30 hours of walking time on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It features 2456 m of ascent and 2326 m of descent. Nearby places include the Imperial Cathedral of Saint Bartholomew within 1200 m, Frankfurt within 1300 m, and Commerzbank within 1700 m.
